blob_finalized_chk.name: blob_finalized_chk
blob_finalized_chk.value: ("blob"."finalized_at" is null) = ("blob"."scan_status" is null) and ("blob"."finalized_at" is null or "blob"."sha256" is not null)

deletion_job_workspace_chk.name: deletion_job_workspace_chk
deletion_job_workspace_chk.value: kind = 'account' or workspace_id is not null

deletion_job_account_user_chk.name: deletion_job_account_user_chk
deletion_job_account_user_chk.value: kind <> 'account' or user_id is not null

export_job_ready_chk.name: export_job_ready_chk
export_job_ready_chk.value: status <> 'ready' or (blob_id is not null and sha256 is not null and expires_at is not null)

feature_flag_legal_ack_chk.name: feature_flag_legal_ack_chk
feature_flag_legal_ack_chk.value: legal_ack_by is null or legal_ack_note is not null

plan_price_chk.name: plan_price_chk
plan_price_chk.value: price_paise >= 0 and (clerk_seat_price_paise is null or clerk_seat_price_paise >= 0)

saas_invoice_number_issued_chk.name: saas_invoice_number_issued_chk
saas_invoice_number_issued_chk.value: status = 'draft' or (number is not null and issue_date is not null)

saas_invoice_amounts_chk.name: saas_invoice_amounts_chk
saas_invoice_amounts_chk.value: taxable_paise >= 0 and cgst_paise >= 0 and sgst_paise >= 0 and igst_paise >= 0 and total_paise >= 0

support_session_granted_chk.name: support_session_granted_chk
support_session_granted_chk.value: status <> 'granted' or (granted_at is not null and expires_at is not null)

support_session_window_chk.name: support_session_window_chk
support_session_window_chk.value: expires_at is null or (granted_at is not null and expires_at > granted_at and expires_at <= granted_at + interval '240 minutes')

workspace_feature_flag_legal_ack_chk.name: workspace_feature_flag_legal_ack_chk
workspace_feature_flag_legal_ack_chk.value: legal_ack_by is null or legal_ack_note is not null
